params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location 'C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
git fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
$branches=@(
'agent/bridge-uia-hardening-20260929',
'agent/bridge-uia-native-20260929',
'agent/control-test-narrow-test-scope-only-build-a-r-20260928133350-vrokm',
'agent/launch-observation-atomicity-20260928',
'agent/swarm-contract-v3-20260929-0540',
'agent-bridge',
'codex/complete-mod-workflows',
'fix/codex-quota-dispatch-circuit-20260929'
)
$out=@()
foreach($b in $branches){
  git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$b"
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ $out += [ordered]@{branch=$b;missing=$true}; continue }
  $commits=@()
  foreach($line in @(git log --format='%H%x09%s' "origin/main..origin/$b")){
    $parts=$line -split "`t",2
    if($parts.Count -ge 2){ $commits += [ordered]@{sha=$parts[0];subject=$parts[1]} }
  }
  $cherry=@(git cherry origin/main "origin/$b")
  $plus=@($cherry | Where-Object {$_ -like '+ *'})
  $minus=@($cherry | Where-Object {$_ -like '- *'})
  $names=@(git diff --name-status "origin/main...origin/$b")
  $stat=(git diff --stat "origin/main...origin/$b" | Out-String).Trim()
  $out += [ordered]@{
    branch=$b
    tip=(git rev-parse "origin/$b" | Out-String).Trim()
    merge_base=(git merge-base origin/main "origin/$b" | Out-String).Trim()
    ahead_count=$commits.Count
    patch_unique_count=$plus.Count
    patch_equivalent_count=$minus.Count
    commits=$commits
    cherry=$cherry
    names=$names
    stat=$stat
  }
}
[ordered]@{main=(git rev-parse origin/main | Out-String).Trim();branches=$out} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7
